info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Decision Tables API

params.name: category
params.description: Only return decision tables with the given category.

params.name: categoryLike
params.description: Only return decision tables with a category like the given name.

params.name: categoryNotEquals
params.description: Only return decision tables which do not have the given category.

params.name: key
params.description: Only return decision tables with the given key.

params.name: keyLike
params.description: Only return decision tables with a name like the given key.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return decision tables with the given name.

params.name: nameLike
params.description: Only return decision tables with a name like the given name.

params.name: resourceName
params.description: Only return decision tables with the given resource name.

params.name: resourceNameLike
params.description: Only return decision tables with a name like the given resource name.

params.name: version
params.description: Only return decision tables with the given version.

params.name: latest
params.description: Only return the latest decision tables versions. Can only be used together with key and keyLike parameters, using any other parameter will result in a 400-response.

params.name: deploymentId
params.description: Only return decision tables with the given category.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return decision tables with the given tenant ID.

params.name: sort
params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.
